newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers 200 MW peak, firm power for Mon.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers 200 MW peak, firm power for Mon.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Monday deliveries, the agency said Friday.
For Friday pre-schedulings, BPA offered 200 MW of firm during heavy load hours at $12.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and at $13.50 at the California Oregon Border (COB).
Unlimited light-load firm power was offered for Monday at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
Unlimited non-firm heavy load power for Monday was offered at 10.00 in both the Northwest and COB, while light-load non-firm power was offered at $9.00 at both points.
For Saturday, unlimited heavy-load firm power was offered at $12.50 in the Northwest and $13.50 at COB, while light load firm power was offered at $9.00 in both the Northwest and COB.

Non-firm heavy load power Saturday for the hours ending 0800 to 2200 PDT was offered at $13.00 in the Northwest and $14.00 at COB, while non-firm light-load power during the hours ending 0100-0700 and 2300-2400 was offered at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
For Sunday, unlimited heavy-load firm power was offered at $11.00 in the Northwest and $12.00 at COB, while light load firm power was offered at $9.00 at both points.

Non-firm heavy load power Sunday for the hours ending 0900 to 2200 PDT was offered at $11.50 in the Northwest and $12.50 at COB, while non-firm light-load power during the hours ending 0100-0800 and 2300-2400 was offered at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
